chapters.label: The quick finish, live
chapters.text: Barcelona against Chelsea, the 2025 Champions League semi-final. A long ball forward. Salma Paralluelo beats Lucy Bronze. Alexia Putellas slips a pass between the defenders. Ewa Pajor bursts through. Goal!

chapters.label: Ready early
chapters.text: Watch again. Before Alexia even passes, Pajor is already on her toes, with her eyes on the gap.

chapters.label: No waiting
chapters.text: So when the ball arrives, she is ready, and finishes fast, past Hannah Hampton!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Be ready before the ball arrives, so you can shoot with one touch.
